facts.fact: FrontPageAfrica reports IDAD, with UNDP funding, began a ten-county awareness rollout of the Citizens Feedback Mechanism, a national SMS (short code 2424) and web platform for citizens to report on public service delivery; no case numbers are given.
The article describes the Citizens Feedback Mechanism as a national platform through which citizens' messages are channelled to the concerned Ministries, Agencies or Commissions.

systems.platform: SMS short code 2424 and web portal
